sdk_source_refs: SGGK topology deserialization for imported ABC SGT bodies
test_goal: Use imported ABC SGT outputs as loaded_sgt targets and recut them with generated tools.
risk_summary: Imported ABC bodies contain realistic complex topology; boolean recut can expose split/imprint/tolerance bugs that primitive-only tests miss.

geometry.tool_builder: solid_cylinder, sweep_circle_line, or extrude_rect generated by corpus recut
geometry.parameter_notes: Use exact coordinate-plane bbox probing before tool placement; conservative SDK bboxes are diagnostic only.

expected_behavior: Generated recuts should be valid, non-empty when expected, and triaged with original ABC source and target/tool contact candidates.
